summary: Full round-3 testing for Route Tower: AI endpoints, Create Shipment modal (AI + manual), Live ETA countdown, Route Playback, AI Co-pilot on shipment detail, Dark 'Control Room' toggle, ROI Estimator, and demo-request regression. All backend AI + leads endpoints pass. All UI flows work end-to-end. No blocking issues found.

issues: lenis console warning: container needs non-static position — carried over from iter2, non-blocking.

feature_verification.backend_ai_create_shipment: PASS — /api/ai/create-shipment returns full JSON with mode/origin/destination/carrier/tracking/eta/status/current, id prefixed CT-, and 3-6 stops with numeric lat/lng. Verified via pytest.
feature_verification.backend_ai_insight: PASS — /api/ai/insight returns {status:success, insight:non-empty paragraph} both with and without a custom question.
feature_verification.create_shipment_ai_flow: PASS — header-create-btn opens create-shipment-modal, create-tab-ai default, ai-prompt+ai-generate produces ai-preview (~5s), ai-confirm creates a shipment (id like CT-49681), toast shown, navigates to /shipment/<id>, then shows up on dashboard table and hero list labelled NEW.
feature_verification.live_countdown: PASS — countdown data-testid shows format like '5d 11:54:55' and ticks every second. Delivered shipments show 'Delivered' (per Countdown.jsx). Shipment detail header shows large 'Live ETA Countdown'.
feature_verification.route_playback: PASS — playback-play advances scrub value (55 -> 74 in 1.5s), playback-marker present in SVG, playback-reset returns to 0, playback-scrub slider updates % text.
feature_verification.ai_copilot: PASS — ai-analyze-btn produces ai-insight-text (~410 chars, specific and shipment-aware). ai-question + Enter also refreshes ai-insight-text with a new, question-specific answer.
feature_verification.dark_control_room: PASS — dark-toggle switches dash-root.bg from rgb(247,247,248) to rgb(10,12,16) and adds .dark class; toggling again reverts. KPIs, charts, table remain readable.
feature_verification.roi_estimator: PASS — sliders change roi-annual live: 12000/6/30/45 -> $59,419; after moving monthly-shipments slider -> $76,699; after also raising hourly cost -> $127,360.
feature_verification.demo_regression: PASS — header-demo-btn -> demo-name/company/email -> demo-submit -> POST /api/leads 200 -> demo-success 'Request received · Our team will reach out to schedule your Route Tower walkthrough.'
feature_verification.brand_check: PASS — 0 occurrences of 'Control Tower' on landing; 'Route Tower' present 11 times.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _gemini creates a fresh LlmChat per call (fine) but there is no timeout guard; a hanging Gemini stream could tie up the request. Consider wrapping in asyncio.wait_for with a sane budget (e.g., 25s) to fail fast to a 502.

server.py: _extract_json trusts the model to return valid JSON; a fallback to a hard-coded stub shipment could improve UX when the model returns malformed output (currently the frontend just toasts an error).

CreateShipmentModal.jsx: manual mode still requires an AI backend call (runManual builds a prompt and calls aiCreateShipment). If AI is down the manual path also fails — consider a pure-frontend fallback that geocodes two stops from CITIES table.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 shipments via UI (localStorage only, ids CT-49681 and CT-81442). Two demo leads submitted (test_iter3@example.com, test_iter3b@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new round-3 features are verified working end-to-end. Note: shipments are browser-only (localStorage key rt_shipments_v1) so cross-session persistence is intentional non-goal. AI calls to /api/ai/* respond in ~3-6s. Countdown assumes ETA parses via new Date(); ISO or 'Aug 24, 2026' style both parse. If AI backend flakes, both AI-create and manual-create in the modal will fail (they both call aiCreateShipment) — consider a fallback for manual mode.
